title: How to deposit MATIC from Polygon Network to tanX?
description:
Fuel Up Your tanX Trades! Depositing MATIC from Polygon Network (Video Guide)
Calling all MATIC holders on Polygon Network! This video sets you on the fast track to depositing MATIC directly from Polygon to your tanX wallet, prepping you for a world of exciting trading opportunities!

In this video, you'll master:

Connecting your Polygon Network wallet to tanX for a smooth transition
The step-by-step process of depositing MATIC directly from the Polygon Network
Important details to remember during the transfer, including gas fees
By the video's end, you'll be equipped to leverage your MATIC holdings and explore the vast trading opportunities on tanX!

Got any questions about depositing MATIC on tanX? Don't hesitate to ask in the comments below!

Links:

Website: tanX.fi: https://tanx.fi
Find us on Twitter: tanXfinance: https://twitter.com/tanXfinance
Join our community on Discord: https://discord.com/invite/wMAnf3gVTh
